description: This Python script provides tools for analyzing, extracting, and creating TP-Link 'tplink2022' image files, which are container images used on TP-Link devices around 2022. It includes functions for decoding headers, extracting sections, and composing new images with support and version information.

methods.name: decode_header(datafile)
methods.description: Reads and decodes the header of a tplink2022 image file into a dictionary containing size and section info.

methods.name: extract(datafile)
methods.description: Extracts sections from the tplink2022 image file into individual binary files, based on header info.

methods.name: get_section_contents(section)
methods.description: Returns the binary data of a section, either from 'data' or by reading from a file, verifying size correctness.

methods.name: write_image(output_image, header)
methods.description: Creates a tplink2022 image file from a header dictionary, including MD5 checksum calculation.

methods.name: encode_soft_verson()
methods.description: Encodes a default or placeholder software version into binary form; purpose unclear.

methods.name: create_image(output_image, root, support)
methods.description: Builds a tplink2022 image with specified root filesystem and support string, including optional version info.

methods.name: main(args)
methods.description: Main execution logic to analyze, extract, or create images based on command-line arguments.
